recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a woman in a textured red long-sleeved dress against a neutral radial gradient background, featuring a mix of elegant script and industrial stencil typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a slight hip tilt for dynamic posture
Red dress color echoing the primary script text color
Radial lighting focusing on the subject's face and upper torso
Contrast between soft script and hard-edged stencil lettering
coreInvariants: High-contrast red and black color accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright red script at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script, moves down to the subject's face, follows the dress line to the secondary text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample neutral space around the head and shoulders to allow for prominent typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for the dress and primary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for secondary text and shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements against a low-saturation, mid-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a connected, upright script with high stroke contrast
Secondary text uses a fragmented, military-style stencil block serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: White drop shadow or outline on the red script to separate it from the background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast stylistic clash between elegant cursive and industrial utility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the upright, bold cursive style of the primary header.
Provides the heavy, fragmented slab-serif look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair, wearing a red long-sleeved v-neck knit dress, standing against a light grey radial gradient background. Soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold red script text at the top with a thin white outline. Add black stencil-style all-caps text on the right side, rotated 15 degrees.

verificationChecks: Is the script text red with a white outline?
Is the secondary text a black stencil font?
Is the background a smooth radial gradient?
Is the subject wearing a red v-neck dress?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the dress texture is visible
Verify the stencil text is rotated correctly
Confirm the script text is centered at the top
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Radial Gradient + (Bold Red Script / Black Stencil) Typography pairing.
